rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an identifiable written text, especially an article or passage.

example.jyutping: ni1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 se2 dak1 hou2 jau5 cuk1

rows.note: Use this for the script or written-language system itself, rather than for a particular written work.

example.english: This writing system is hard to learn.
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 man4 zi6 hou2 naan4 hok6

rows.note: Choose this for a finished work viewed as something created by an author, rather than simply as text.

example.english: This writing is their best work.
example.traditional: 呢篇作品係佢哋寫得最好嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 pin1 zok3 ban2 hai6 keoi5 dei6 se2 dak1 zeoi3 hou2 ge3

rows.note: Use this for a person's handwriting or penmanship, especially when commenting on how readable or attractive it is.

example.jyutping: nei5 di1 sau2 zi6 zan1 hai6 leng3
